reviews.title: Runs Great on my older Linux PC
reviews.comment:
I have an older desktop PC that I repurposed by installing a Linux operating system.  When the Linux Mint OS that I use updated to release 22.2, it no longer supported the the NVidia graphics card that was in the PC.  I chose this AMD card as a replacement as Mint supports this AMD GPU.  Although modest in specs, it seemed like this would be a good replacement choice for the price, and indeed it was.  The card is not that heavy but seems well built, fits nicely in the case, and does not require an additional slot or an external power connector.
When it arrived I simply just plugged it in the PC's bus and secured the card.  When I turned the PC on it just worked - no drivers to install, no tricky settings to adjust.  Best of all, the fan is very quiet.  Now, I'm not into heavy gaming so this GPU is more than sufficient for my needs.  No matter what I throw at it, it always comes through.  HD videos run great, and what few games I have never dropped frames.  Very satisfied.
*It should be noted that AMD GPUs do not support processing of AI LLMs locally where NVidia GPUs are designed to support AI processing locally.

reviews.title: Great graphics card for the price!!
reviews.comment: I am so pleased that I bought this graphics card. I was a little skeptackle to buy it at first because of the price and reading some of the bad reviews. However this card turned out to be very good. I have an HP Elitebook 800 G3 I5 7500 tower and anyone who knows about them know they are good computers but compact so price wasn't the issue in buying a graphics card for it space was. After this card arrived I installed it with no issues. Then I went to the AMD website and installed those drivers and software. Everything works like a champ including playing my favorite video games like Call of Duty Black OPS III, Grand Theft Auto V and many other modern video games. The vido quality is good as well as tghe resolution and it doen't draw a lot of power to operate. It also doesn't overheat while playing my favorite games. For those saying they have so much trouble installing drivers, all you have to do is go to AMD. Anyway I would definitely recommend this card.
reviews.author: Christopher Wells

reviews.title: Works, but I ran into some driver issues
reviews.comment:
Needed a card to drive two monitors and this works good. Card is quiet.
This isn’t the fault of the card itself, but I ran into a weird issue where Windows decided the driver in Windows Update was newer than the current AMD driver. The driver in Windows Update caused the card to not work correctly and throw errors on my system. Forcing Windows to stop overwriting the latest AMD driver however made things work correctly.

reviews.title: Made my older PC run great using Linux with this AMD card.
reviews.comment:
I have an older Dell XPS 8700 that worked fine with Windows 10, but was not capable of upgrading to WIn 11.  My PC had a Nvidia card that worked fine under Windows.
So, I switched to Linux Mint and the Nvidia card had limited driver support under Linux and I was getting artifacts in the monitors.  So I swapped out my Nvidia card with this AMD card and it works GREAT!  My older PC runs like new again!
By the way, there was no way I would buy a new PC just to run WIn11, and I'm glad I switched to Linux.
reviews.author: Dave
